description: Synthetic Emberwick trips in VictoriaMetrics: victoriametrics_seed imports the last 15 days and VictoriaMetrics scrapes devorigin for the rest. Also exercises MetricsQL-only syntax and the seeded edge-case fixtures. Query VictoriaMetrics directly or through Trickster.

panels.description: Exact trips per 5-minute window: the counter's change over 5m, evaluated every 5m. Matches the SQL dashboards' 5m buckets.
panels.title: # Trips Over Time (5m buckets)

panels.description: Exact trips per step, whatever step Grafana picks for the time range.
panels.title: # Trips Over Time ($__interval)

panels.description: Average amount charged and tip per trip, per 15-minute window.
panels.title: Fare Metrics (15m buckets)

panels.description: Trips picked up in each borough over the dashboard's time range.
panels.title: Trips by Pickup Borough

panels.description: Trips picked up and not yet dropped off, a gauge that rises and falls with demand.
panels.title: Trips In Progress
% Trips Paid w/ Credit Card (5m buckets)

panels.description: Distance quantiles from the trips_distance_miles histogram.
panels.title: Trip Distance (p50 / p90)

panels.description: A WITH expression defining a reusable delta15() template, expanded by VictoriaMetrics. PromQL has no WITH.
panels.title: WITH Template: Trips per 15m

panels.description: MetricsQL fills in omitted range windows: rate(trips_total) uses the query step. PromQL requires an explicit [window].
panels.title: Implicit Lookbehind: rate() and increase()

panels.description: keep_metric_names preserves __name__ through increase(), so sum by (__name__) splits fares and tips. Without it the names drop and the two series collapse into one.
panels.title: Metric Names Kept: keep_metric_names

panels.description: topk_avg keeps the 3 boroughs with the highest average and sums the rest into borough="other".
panels.title: topk_avg with Remainder: Trips per Hour by Borough

panels.description: One histogram_quantiles call returns several quantiles, labeled by q. The inner rate() uses an implicit window.
panels.title: histogram_quantiles: Trip Distance p50 / p90 / p99

panels.description: rollup() returns min, max and avg series over each window, labeled by rollup, here over a subquery.
panels.title: rollup(): Trips In Progress min / avg / max per 15m

panels.description: The limit modifier caps an aggregation's output series count; which series survive is not ranked.
panels.title: limit Modifier: Any 3 Boroughs

panels.description: The __graphite__ pseudo-label selects the Graphite fixture series with a Graphite wildcard, inside MetricsQL.
panels.title: Native Graphite Selector in MetricsQL
Edge-Case Fixtures (job=trickster_fixtures, last 48h; extended on each seeding)

panels.description: trickster_fixture_resets_total restarts at 0 every hour and drops to a quarter of its value at :30. rate() and increase() must treat both drops as resets.
panels.title: Counter Resets: Hourly to Zero, Half-Hourly to a Quarter

panels.description: trickster_fixture_irregular repeats intervals of 7, 15, 23, 61, 300, 15 and 30 seconds. The bare selector leaves gaps where samples are 300s apart; last_over_time with a wide window does not.
panels.title: Irregular Intervals: 7s to 300s Gaps

panels.description: trickster_fixture_missing is a 15s series with periodic and long gaps; count_over_time shows how many samples each 1m window holds.
panels.title: Missing Samples: 2m Gaps Every 10m, 20m Outage Every 6h

panels.description: trickster_fixture_special cycles 1.5, +Inf, 2.5, -Inf each minute. NaN is absent: VictoriaMetrics drops NaN samples on import. clamp() keeps the metric name in MetricsQL.
panels.title: +Inf / -Inf Values

panels.description: trickster_fixture_name_a_total and _b_total share label sets. rate() over both fails with duplicate output series unless keep_metric_names is set.
panels.title: Metric-Name Collisions: Two Names, Same Labels

panels.description: trickster_fixture_gauge: a 15s sine wave with deterministic noise; every fixture value is a function of its timestamp.
panels.title: Regular Gauge Baseline
